tools.name: create_issue
tools.title: Create Jira Issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a Jira project, setting its type, summary and any required fields. Use when raising new work; update_issue changes an issue that already exists.

issue_type.description: The issue type, for example Task, Bug, or Story.

project_key.description: The Jira project key, for example AR.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.title: Get Jira Issue
tools.description: Return one Jira issue with its fields, comments and change history. Use when you have the issue key or id; list_issues searches for issues by JQL.

issue_key.description: Issue ID or key, for example PROJ-123.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add Jira Comment
tools.description: Post a comment onto an existing Jira issue, optionally restricted to a project role or group. Use when you have the issue key or id; get_issue returns the comments already on it.

issue_key.description: Issue ID or key, for example PROJ-123.

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.title: Transition Jira Issue
tools.description: Move a Jira issue through a workflow transition, optionally setting fields as it moves. Use when changing one issue's status; bulk_transition_issues moves many.

issue_key.description: Issue ID or key, for example AR-167.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get Jira Project
tools.description: Return one Jira project, including its key, lead, type and components. Use when you hold the project key; get_projects searches for one.

expand.description:
Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Note that the project description, issue types, and project lead are included in all responses by default. Expand options include:

 *  `description` The project description.
 *  `issueTypes` The issue types associated with the project.
 *  `lead` The project lead.
 *  `projectKeys` All project keys associated with the project.
 *  `issueTypeHierarchy` The project issue type hierarchy.

project_key.description: The project ID or project key (case sensitive).

properties.description: A list of project properties to return for the project. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list.
